collection.title: VW Arteon 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The WW Arteon 2017 Onwards model requires a 26" wiper blade for the drivers side and a 19" for the passengers side with the Slim Push Button arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
